name: Samaritan House VITA
description: Free in-person tax preparation by IRS-certified volunteers
fullDescription: Samaritan House provides free in-person tax preparation through the IRS VITA program for San Mateo County residents at its San Mateo headquarters.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free in-person tax preparation (no virtual appointments)
- Federal and state returns
- Help with tax credits
- IRS-certified volunteers with a quality review before filing
- Copy of your filed return
howToGetIt:
1. Sign up for a tax appointment online
2. Gather all required tax documents
3. Bring your documents to Samaritan House headquarters and complete an intake form
4. A preparer completes your return and a quality reviewer confirms it with you
5. Your return is filed once you approve it
keywords: Samaritan House, VITA, San Mateo, free tax preparation, in-person tax help, tax credits, IRS certified, San Mateo County
